Relanding 'update_engine: Add XZ compression for CrOS' This patch implements XZ compression for Chrome OS. It is only activated for only delta payload at this point. The XZ compression is typically slower than Bzip2 to compress, but faster to decompress. However, it uses slightly higher memory in decompression. It compresses about 5%-10% better than the current Bzip2. usbc: Moving PPC init after setting TCPC resistors. We don't want the PPC to connect the CC lines from the TCPC to the USB connector until the TCPC resistors are set in a valid state (SINK initially). If we connect the CC lines (happens in the ppc_init) before setting the resistor values, some TCPC will be toggling the CC line between Rp/Rd since it doesn't detect a cable yet. In the dead battery charging case, connecting the toggling CC lines to the charger can rail the CC lines to 3.3 V signaling to the charger to disconnect Vbus, thus browning out the board. BRANCH=none BUG=b:71865251 TEST=Grunt powers on via usbc p0 with and without USB hub. modemfwd: load text format protos While we lose the ability to make all of the messages LITE, we gain debuggability and easier test writing, as well as eliding the proto compilation when packaging up firmware directories. It also simplifies reading protos out of files since those no longer require us to roll our own file reader stream. This also changes the name of the manifest prototxt files so that it's theoretically possible to use the same directory as both the helper and firmware dir, which might be useful if you want to send around one package during bringup, and using the .prototxt extension makes it more obvious that this is a text format proto file.
